title.zh-TW: 沙盒新增 minimal 與資料夾寫入控制
title.en: Minimal sandbox profile and folder write controls

body.zh-TW:
想讓 Grok 在專案資料夾裡幫忙做事，又想控制它能不能直接改動你啟動程式的那個資料夾？現在可以透過沙盒（限制程式存取範圍的隔離環境）來細部設定。

這次新增了 `minimal` 沙盒設定檔，以及 `workspace_write` 選項。建立自訂沙盒設定檔時，就能用它們控制啟動資料夾的寫入權限。⟦借用實驗室的工作台時，以前你沒辦法單獨控管眼前這張桌面能不能塗寫，現在除了有精簡版守則，還能直接設定那張桌面可不可以寫入。⟧
body.en:
Want Grok to work inside a project folder while controlling whether it can modify the folder where you launched it? You can now fine-tune that through a sandbox (an isolated environment that restricts program access).

This update adds a `minimal` sandbox profile and a `workspace_write` option. When creating a custom sandbox profile, you can use them to control write permissions for the launch folder. ⟦When borrowing a lab workbench, you used to have no way to separately control whether the desk in front of you could be written on; now, besides a streamlined set of rules, you can directly set whether that desk allows writing.⟧

items.original: New `minimal` sandbox profile and `workspace_write` option let custom profiles control launch-folder writes

title.zh-TW: grok update 改交自我更新版接手
title.en: grok update hands off to self-updating build

body.zh-TW: 想替手邊的 Grok 升級，只要打開終端機執行 `grok update`。在需要的情況下，這個指令現在會把更新任務轉交給放在 `~/.grok/bin` 路徑底下的自我更新版本來接手執行。
body.en: To upgrade your copy of Grok, just open a terminal and run `grok update`. When needed, this command now hands off the update task to the self-updating build located under `~/.grok/bin`.

items.original: `grok update` now delegates to the self-updating build in `~/.grok/bin` when needed

title.zh-TW: grok -p --resume 需有效工作階段 ID
title.en: grok -p --resume requires a valid session ID

body.zh-TW:
用指令列接續先前的對話紀錄，漏填編號常常要等程式跑起來才發現不對勁。現在執行 `grok -p --resume` 時，必須提供有效的工作階段 ID。

如果參數後面留空或給了空值，指令會在一開始就直接拒絕執行。
body.en:
When resuming a previous conversation from the command line, a missing ID often goes unnoticed until the program is already running. Running `grok -p --resume` now requires a valid session ID.

If you leave the argument blank or pass an empty value, the command refuses to run right at the start.

items.original: `grok -p --resume` now requires a valid session ID and refuses empty values early

title.zh-TW: /debug tps 不再計入重試與壓縮等待
title.en: /debug tps excludes retry and compaction waits

body.zh-TW:
想查看目前 Grok 的輸出速度，許多人會輸入 `/debug tps` 來檢查每秒處理的 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）數量。

這個指令算出來的每秒速率，現在會把模型重試的等待時間，以及對話自動壓縮時的等待時間排除在外。⟦跑馬拉松的人看平均配速時，以前連在補給站停下來喘氣的時間都算進去，現在會把這些等待時間扣掉。⟧
body.en:
To check Grok's current output speed, many users run `/debug tps` to see how many tokens (text units AI uses for processing and billing) are processed per second.

The per-second rate calculated by this command now excludes wait times from model retries and automatic conversation compaction. ⟦A marathon runner checking average pace used to include time spent catching a breath at aid stations, and now those wait times are subtracted.⟧

items.original: `/debug tps` excludes model retry and auto-compaction waits from the tokens-per-second rate

title.zh-TW: 無頭模式不再觸發多餘回合摘要呼叫
title.en: Headless runs skip extra turn-summary calls

body.zh-TW: 用腳本讓 Grok 在背景自動執行任務，常會開 headless（沒有終端機視窗或視覺介面的無頭執行模式）。這類執行現在不再觸發多餘的模型呼叫來生成回合摘要。
body.en: Scripts that run Grok automatically in the background often use headless mode (running without a terminal window or visual interface). These runs no longer trigger unnecessary model calls to generate turn summaries.

items.original: Headless runs no longer trigger unnecessary turn-summary model calls

title.zh-TW: 有 Grok Node 設定時 hook 不共用身分
title.en: Hooks keep separate identities with Grok Node settings

body.zh-TW:
有些使用者會在環境裡搭配 Grok 自己的 Node 執行環境設定，並掛上 hook（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）。過去只要存在這組 Node 設定，hook 彼此就會共用同一個識別身分。

現在只要環境裡有 Grok 自己的 Node 設定，各個 hook 就不會再共用同一個身分。
body.en:
Some users configure Grok's own Node runtime settings in their environment and attach hooks (small programs triggered when specific events occur). Previously, whenever those Node settings were present, hooks shared the same identity.

Now, even when Grok's own Node settings are in the environment, individual hooks no longer share a single identity.

items.original: Hooks no longer share an identity when Grok's own Node settings are present

title.zh-TW: 對話紀錄新增訊息收合鍵與邊緣自動捲動
title.en: Transcript message folding and edge autoscroll

body.zh-TW:
對話越聊越長，在滿頁文字裡重讀自己提過的問題或反白選字常會卡手。

遇到較長的使用者訊息，現在直接在對話紀錄裡按 `Enter` 或 `Ctrl+F`，就能把該則訊息展開或收合。

從對話紀錄開始拖曳選取文字時，只要游標拉到窗格邊緣，畫面就會立刻自動捲動。⟦讀很長的紙本卷軸時，以前得整卷攤開慢慢滑，現在可以把太長的那段先折起來，手一拉到邊界卷軸也會跟著捲動。⟧
body.en:
As a conversation grows longer, rereading your earlier questions or selecting text across a full page can feel clunky.

For longer user messages, pressing `Enter` or `Ctrl+F` directly in the transcript now expands or collapses the message.

When dragging to select text from the transcript, the view now autoscrolls immediately as soon as the cursor reaches the pane edge. ⟦Picture reading a long paper scroll where you used to unroll the whole thing and slide through slowly; now you can fold away the overly long section, and the scroll moves along as soon as your hand reaches the edge.⟧

items.original:
`Enter` (or `Ctrl+F`) expands or collapses long user messages directly in the transcript
Drag selection from transcript text now autoscrolls immediately at the pane edge

title.zh-TW: Ctrl+O 複製最新回覆；複製行內程式碼帶反引號
title.en: Ctrl+O copies latest reply; inline code keeps backticks

body.zh-TW:
想把 Grok 給的答案貼進筆記或文件，以後不必再用滑鼠慢慢反白整段話。

按下 `Ctrl+O`，就能直接複製最新一則助手回覆。

從表格、提問卡片或全螢幕檢視器裡複製文字出來時，行內程式碼前後現在也會一併附上反引號（用來標示程式碼的成對撇號）。⟦翻食譜書想影印重點時，以前得自己拿紙遮住邊角，印出來還少了螢光筆標記，現在按一下就能複製整段，連標註記號都一起帶走。⟧
body.en:
When you want to paste Grok's answer into notes or a document, you no longer need to drag your mouse over the whole block.

Pressing `Ctrl+O` directly copies the latest assistant reply.

When copying text from tables, question cards, or the fullscreen viewer, inline code now also includes backticks (paired marks used to delimit code) around it. ⟦Imagine wanting to photocopy a key passage from a cookbook: you used to cover the margins with paper by hand and still lose your highlighter marks on the copy, whereas now one press copies the whole passage along with its markup.⟧

items.original:
`Ctrl+O` now copies the latest assistant reply
Copied text from tables, question cards and the fullscreen viewer now includes backticks around inline code

title.zh-TW: 登入畫面顯示與多視窗狀態處理修正
title.en: Sign-in rendering and multi-window state fixes

body.zh-TW:
換帳號重登或在舊版 Windows 環境操作，登入步驟很容易出岔子。

登入畫面現在在舊版 Windows 主控台也能正常顯示畫面。登出帳號或中途取消登入後，下次回到登入畫面也會從頭重新開始。

使用瀏覽器登入時，會依照當下儲存的那筆登入資訊來完成手續。要是另一個視窗已經先把這筆登入移除了，這次登入就會被拒絕。
body.en:
Switching accounts or working on legacy Windows can easily trip up the sign-in flow.

The sign-in screen now renders properly on the legacy Windows console. After logging out or cancelling mid-login, returning to the sign-in screen starts fresh from the beginning.

Browser sign-in completes against the login currently stored. If another window has already removed that login, the sign-in attempt is refused.

items.original:
Sign-in screen now renders correctly on the legacy Windows console, and starts fresh after logout or a cancelled login
Browser sign-in finishes against the login stored now, and is refused if another window removed that login

title.zh-TW: 畫面未出現或剛切換時不再誤觸按鍵與點擊
title.en: Prevent premature keystrokes and stale welcome-screen clicks

body.zh-TW:
打字或點滑鼠比畫面快半拍，過去很容易意外送出確認或點錯按鈕。

詢問是否信任資料夾的提示還沒出現在畫面上之前，預先敲的按鍵現在不會被讀入。

在歡迎畫面上點按時，如果介面剛好在下一個畫面更新前變動，那一下點擊也不會再觸發錯誤的動作。
body.en:
Typing or clicking ahead of the screen used to make it easy to confirm by mistake or hit the wrong button.

Before the folder trust prompt appears on screen, keystrokes typed ahead of time are no longer accepted.

When clicking on the welcome screen, if the UI happens to change right before the next frame updates, that click no longer triggers the wrong action.

items.original:
Folder trust prompt no longer accepts keystrokes typed before the question appears on screen
Clicks on the welcome screen no longer fire the wrong action when the UI changes before the next frame

title.zh-TW: 提問互動時保留輸入草稿並修好上方向鍵
title.en: Keep composer drafts during questions and fix the up arrow

body.zh-TW:
畫面跳出提問要你回應，手邊可能正要打字作答，或是順手編輯排隊中的提示詞。

畫面上開著提問視窗，你正在編輯一筆排隊中的提示詞時，就算那列排隊項目突然消失，輸入框裡的草稿現在也會保留下來。

在提問的文字作答區裡，只要游標位在最上面那一行，按上方向鍵就會直接移回前一個選項。
body.en:
When a question pops up for your response, you might be about to type an answer or editing a queued prompt.

While a question is open and you are editing a queued prompt, your draft in the composer is now preserved even if that queued row suddenly disappears.

In a question's text answer field, pressing the up arrow key now moves straight back to the previous option whenever the cursor is on the top line.

items.original:
Queued prompt edits keep your composer draft when the queued row disappears under an open question
Up arrow in a question's text answer moves to the previous option when at the top line

title.zh-TW: 修正精簡模式縮放與開登入選單的游標閃爍
title.en: Fix caret flicker when resizing in minimal mode or opening the sign-in chooser

body.zh-TW: 拉動視窗邊緣調整大小，或打開畫面挑選登入方式，打字的那條線過去會不停跳動。這個問題已經修好，現在在精簡模式縮放視窗，或開啟登入選擇器時，游標都不會再閃爍。
body.en: Dragging a window edge to resize it, or opening the screen to pick a sign-in method, used to make the typing line jump around nonstop. That issue is fixed, so the caret no longer flickers when resizing the window in minimal mode or opening the sign-in chooser.

items.original: Caret no longer flickers when resizing the window in minimal mode or opening the sign-in chooser

title.zh-TW: API 金鑰模型提示改為只顯示一次
title.en: API-key model note now shows only once

body.zh-TW: 打開模型清單切換模型，畫面上會附帶一則關於 API 金鑰（向服務驗證身分的專屬密碼）模型的提醒。這則提醒現在只會在你第一次打開任何模型清單時出現，之後就不會再顯示。
body.en: When you open a model list to switch models, the screen includes a note about models that use an API key (a secret credential for verifying your identity with a service). That note now appears only the first time you open any model list and will not show up again afterward.

items.original: The API-key model note now appears only the first time you open any model list and never again

title.zh-TW: Windows Git 輔助工具改用隨附 MinGit
title.en: Windows Git helpers switch to bundled MinGit

body.zh-TW: 在電腦上用 Grok 追蹤檔案修改紀錄，背後需要相關小程式幫忙處理。Windows 上的 Git（追蹤檔案修改歷史的版本控制工具）輔助工具，現在改用程式隨附的 MinGit 執行檔。
body.en: Tracking file change history with Grok on your computer relies on small helper programs behind the scenes. Git (a version-control tool that tracks file change history) helpers on Windows now use the bundled MinGit binary.

items.original: Windows Git helpers now use the bundled MinGit binary

title.zh-TW: 中文字與長訊息不再撐爆視窗與表格
title.en: Chinese text and long messages no longer overflow windows or tables

body.zh-TW:
輸入中文提示或貼上大段內容，過去寬字元容易讓預覽和表格對不齊、甚至溢出邊界。

提示詞裡含有中文字或全形符號這類寬字元時，任務窗格與列表窗格現在能正確對齊搜尋狀態，排程任務的預覽文字也會妥善截斷。

貼上很長的內容時，預覽結尾的省略符號在所有終端機上都能正確顯示。

終端機視窗標題遇到中日韓文字、emoji 或 Windows 路徑時，現在會正確截斷，不會再超出範圍。

指令列的表格與進度訊息也改用統一的省略符號樣式，遇到較寬的文字不會再溢出。

⟦在格子有限的表格紙上寫筆記，以前遇到中文字或特殊符號常會一路超出格子外，現在寫到邊界就會整齊收尾並標上省略符號。⟧
body.en:
When entering Chinese prompts or pasting large blocks of text, wide characters used to misalign previews and tables or even push them past their boundaries.

When prompts contain wide characters like Chinese text or full-width symbols, the tasks pane and list panes now properly align search status, and scheduled-task preview text is cleanly truncated.

When pasting very long content, the ellipsis at the end of previews now renders properly across all terminals.

Terminal window titles now truncate properly when encountering CJK characters, emoji, or Windows paths instead of overflowing.

CLI tables and progress messages also now use a consistent ellipsis style and no longer overflow with wide text.

⟦Picture writing notes on grid paper with fixed cells: Chinese characters or special symbols used to spill past the lines, whereas now they stop neatly at the border with an ellipsis.⟧

CLI tables and progress messages now use the same ellipsis style and no longer overflow with wide text

title.zh-TW: 窄終端機下詢問卡片不當機、計量條顯示完整
title.en: Elicitation cards stop crashing and meters stay complete in narrow terminals

body.zh-TW:
你把終端機視窗縮小放在螢幕角落工作時，有一個畫面以前會當機：MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）向你詢問資訊的詢問卡片。

這類提示現在改為「MCP server …」開頭，跟其他介面的用語一致。詢問卡片在非常窄或非常短的終端機區域裡顯示，也不會再當機。

目標預算計量條在很窄的終端機裡，現在一定會同時顯示左右括號和百分比數字。

設定裡的排版密度預覽，現在在同樣窄的寬度下也會出現，跟同一個彈出視窗裡的另一個預覽一致。

⟦就像折疊式小桌子縮進角落時，以前詢問卡片那一面會整個卡住打不開，其他幾面只是缺了邊角；現在收窄後，每一面都能完整攤開給你看。⟧
body.en:
When you shrink your terminal window into a corner of the screen to work, one screen used to crash: the elicitation card where MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol for connecting AI to external tools) asks you for information.

These prompts now start with "MCP server …" to match the rest of the UI. Elicitation cards also no longer crash when drawn in very narrow or very short terminal areas.

Goal budget meters in very narrow terminals now always display both brackets and the percentage.

The density preview in Settings now appears at the same narrow widths, matching the other preview in the same modal.

⟦Like a small folding table tucked into a corner, the elicitation card side used to jam shut completely while the other sides merely lost their edges; now, even when narrowed, every side unfolds cleanly in full view.⟧

items.original:
MCP elicitation prompts now read "MCP server …" to match the rest of the UI, and elicitation cards no longer crash when drawn in very narrow or short terminal areas
Goal budget meters now always show both brackets and the percentage even in narrow terminals
The density preview in Settings now appears at the same narrow widths as the other preview in the same modal

title.zh-TW: 列表焦點與摺疊圖示更清楚且不抖動
title.en: Clearer list focus and disclosure icons without jitter

body.zh-TW:
操作彈出視窗和各種工作列表，游標停在哪一列、哪個群組已經展開，畫面上的標記都一起調整過。

彈出視窗裡的可摺疊列在展開時會顯示向下箭頭，更容易區分已展開的群組與最底層的單一列。

各處的可摺疊列現在統一使用相同的展開收合圖示，在舊版主控台上也能正確切換成備援符號。

意見回饋的「Drafts」草稿清單中被選取的項目，現在會顯示與其他地方相同的反白亮帶，其餘文字顏色也一致。

進入 Workflows 畫面的代理清單時，版面不會再抖動，空白訊息也能正確對齊。

在 Rose Pine Moon 與 Oscura 主題下，取得焦點的輸入框邊框現在明顯比選中的歷史紀錄項目更亮。
body.en:
When navigating modals and work lists, the visual cues showing which row the cursor is on and which groups are expanded have all been refined.

Foldable rows in modals now show a down chevron when open, making expanded groups easier to tell apart from single leaf rows.

Collapsible rows everywhere now use the same expand and collapse icons and fall back properly on legacy consoles.

Selected items in the feedback "Drafts" list now show the same highlight band used elsewhere, and other text colors remain consistent.

Moving focus into the agent list in the Workflows view no longer causes layout jitter, and empty messages align properly.

In the Rose Pine Moon and Oscura themes, the focused prompt border is now visibly brighter than a selected scrollback entry.

title.zh-TW: 快捷鍵與操作提示改用統一寫法
title.en: Consistent formatting for keyboard shortcuts and action hints

body.zh-TW:
不記得某個視窗怎麼操作，低頭看畫面底部的小字提示是最快的辦法。

多個彈出視窗底部的導覽提示，現在統一改用方向鍵表示，不再顯示 `j` 或 `k`。

介面各處的按鍵提示統一改用 `Ctrl+` 標記，按鍵名稱也統一改為每個單字字首大寫。

至於 SSH（遠端連線）換行、選字與對話上下文用量的情境小提示，風格也已跟其他提示對齊。

⟦跟整棟大樓換上同一套樓層指示牌一樣，以前每扇門旁標記的符號各寫各的，現在抬頭就能用同一種規矩看懂怎麼走。⟧
body.en:
When you forget how to navigate a modal, glancing down at the small hints along the bottom is the fastest way.

Navigation hints in several modal footers now consistently use arrow keys instead of `j` or `k`.

Key hints throughout the UI now use `Ctrl+` notation consistently, with key names standardized to Title Case.

Contextual tips for SSH (remote connection) wrapping, word selection, and conversation context usage now also match the style of other tips.

⟦Think of an entire building switching to one uniform set of floor signs: each door used to have its own ad-hoc symbols, whereas now you can look up and follow the same rules anywhere.⟧

items.original:
Navigation hints in several modal footers now consistently use arrow keys instead of j/k
Key hints throughout the UI now use consistent Ctrl+ notation and Title-case key names
Contextual tips for SSH wrap, word selection and context usage now match the style of other tips

title.zh-TW: 失敗通知原因更明確且訊息標點統一
title.en: Clearer failure notices and consistent message punctuation

body.zh-TW:
遇到傳送失敗或恢復對話出錯，畫面上跳出的那一小行字決定你能不能立刻看懂問題出在哪。

使用立即送出或插話卻失敗時，通知視窗會先寫明原本的錯誤原因，再註記已重新排入佇列；對話分岔被拒絕的提示也改用一致的措辭。

只有一句話的系統通知、斜線指令錯誤、彈出視窗訊息、計畫核准通知與命令列成功訊息，句尾現在不再加上句點。

恢復對話選擇器裡的錯誤訊息，措辭和標點符號也統一調整成一致的寫法。
body.en:
When a send fails or resuming a conversation hits an error, that one-line notice popping up on screen determines whether you can immediately see what went wrong.

When send-now or an interjection fails, the toast notice now states the original error first before noting the requeue; fork refusal messages also use consistent wording.

One-sentence system notices, slash command errors, modal messages, plan-approval notices, and CLI success messages no longer end with a period.

Error messages in the resume picker now also use consistent wording and punctuation.

items.original:
Send-now and interjection failure toasts now clearly state the original error before noting the requeue; fork refusals use consistent wording
One-sentence system notices, slash errors, modal messages, plan-approval notices and CLI success messages no longer end with a period
Resume picker error messages now use consistent wording and punctuation

title.zh-TW: 英文標籤大小寫與空白提示用語統一
title.en: Consistent capitalization and empty-state wording across UI labels

body.zh-TW:
平時翻看設定頁面、目標詳情或空白的資料夾選擇器，畫面上的短英文標籤會直接影響你第一眼的判讀。

MCP 與負責程式語言分析的 LSP 伺服器標籤，加上 URL 複製提示，全介面現在統一改用大寫拼寫。

設定、目標詳情、各處標題與空白的指令模式欄位，現在統一改用句首大寫；計畫核准狀態也改顯示「Waiting for plan approval」。

介面顯示數量遇到單數時不再一律用複數結尾，例如會正確寫成「1 page」或「1 hook」（特定事件發生時觸發的小程式）。

任務窗格的空白畫面提示與工具用量窗格標題，現在跟周圍介面的用詞保持一致。

清單沒有項目時，選擇器會直接點明缺了什麼，例如顯示「No sessions in this directory」代表此目錄沒有工作階段，或顯示「No subfolders」，文字絕不會超出邊框。
body.en:
When browsing settings, goal details, or an empty folder picker, short UI labels directly shape how quickly you read the screen.

Labels for MCP servers, LSP servers that handle programming language analysis, and URL copy hints now use consistent uppercase spelling throughout the UI.

Settings, goal details, various titles, and the empty command-pattern field now use consistent sentence case; plan approval status now reads "Waiting for plan approval".

Singular counts in the UI no longer always use plural endings, so they now properly read "1 page" or "1 hook" (a small program triggered by a specific event).

The tasks pane empty state and tool-usage pane title now match surrounding UI wording.

When a list has no items, pickers state directly what is missing, such as "No sessions in this directory" or "No subfolders", and the text never overflows the border.

Empty pickers now say what is empty ("No sessions in this directory", "No subfolders") and never overflow the border

title.zh-TW: 窄版終端機不再裁切按鈕與資訊
title.en: Narrow terminals no longer clip buttons and info

body.zh-TW:
在筆電分割視窗或小窗格裡開 Grok Build，再也不用為了看全畫面一直拉寬視窗。

用量視窗不再把額度條和帳單網址切掉。

Read 標頭和影片疊加層面對窄版終端機與中日韓文字時，都能正常顯示。

Dashboard 預覽面板現在會秀出全部選項並留住輸入框，寬度在 40 到 43 欄時會改用精簡的工作階段列。

計畫審查的按鈕也能維持看得到、點得到。⟦就像小尺寸海報重新排版一樣，以前字句和聯絡方式常在邊緣被裁掉半截，現在把版面收緊，該有的資訊和按鍵都留在框裡。⟧
body.en:
When opening Grok Build in a split laptop window or a small pane, you no longer have to keep widening the window just to see the whole screen.

The Usage modal no longer clips the credit bar or billing URL.

Read headers and video overlays now display properly on narrow terminals and with Chinese, Japanese, and Korean text.

Dashboard peek now shows all options and keeps the input box visible, switching to compact session rows at 40 to 43 columns.

Plan review buttons also stay visible and clickable. ⟦Picture re-laying out a small poster: words and contact details used to get cut off at the edges, but tightening the layout keeps all the info and buttons inside the frame.⟧

items.original:

title.zh-TW: 按 Ctrl+E 後思考區塊會維持展開
title.en: Thinking blocks stay expanded after pressing Ctrl+E

body.zh-TW:
寫企劃盯著 AI 一步步推論的過程，看到關鍵處最怕展開的畫面突然自己收起來。

現在按下 `Ctrl+E` 展開全部後，思考區塊（模型在正式回答前顯示推理步驟的區域）在串流輸出期間都會維持展開狀態。⟦打開白板旁的演算筆記看老師解題，以前剛掀開看兩眼，筆記本就自己闔回去，現在攤開後會一路平放到底。⟧
body.en:
When writing a proposal and watching the AI reason step by step, the last thing you want at a key moment is for the expanded view to collapse on its own.

Now, after pressing `Ctrl+E` to expand all, thinking blocks (the area where the model shows its reasoning steps before the final answer) stay expanded while streaming. ⟦You open a scratchpad next to the whiteboard to watch a teacher solve a problem—before, the notebook would snap shut after a quick glance, and now it stays flat open all the way through.⟧

items.original: Thinking blocks stay expanded while streaming after pressing Ctrl+E to expand all

title.zh-TW: 網頁抓取失敗展開後會顯示實際原因
title.en: Failed web fetches show the actual reason when expanded

body.zh-TW:
請 AI 幫忙查一份線上報價單，結果卻沒讀到東西，最想知道的就是到底哪裡卡住。

現在網頁抓取失敗後，只要把該筆紀錄展開，畫面上就會列出實際的錯誤原因。⟦好比寄掛號信被退件，以前信封上只蓋個「投遞失敗」的章，現在翻開背面附條，就能看清是因為地址寫錯還是沒人簽收。⟧
body.en:
When you ask the AI to check an online quote and it reads nothing back, what you want to know most is where it got stuck.

Now, when a web fetch fails, expanding that entry lists the actual error reason on screen. ⟦A returned registered letter used to bear only a "Delivery failed" stamp on the envelope, whereas flipping to the slip on the back now shows whether the address was wrong or nobody signed for it.⟧

items.original: Failed web fetches now show the actual error reason when expanded

title.zh-TW: Shift 拖曳複製不再多帶行尾方塊字元
title.en: Shift-drag copy no longer adds a trailing block character

body.zh-TW:
把終端機裡的幾段分析複製貼到筆記本，偶爾會發現每行尾巴都黏著多餘的東西。

在捲軸旁邊按住 `Shift` 拖曳選取文字並複製時，現在每行結尾不會再多帶一個方塊字元。⟦撕下牆面膠帶時，以前邊緣總會勾著一絲殘膠一起掀起來，得另外用手摳掉，現在從頭拉到尾都是平整的一條。⟧
body.en:
When you copy a few paragraphs of analysis from the terminal into your notes, you occasionally find extra clutter stuck to the end of every line.

When you hold `Shift` and drag to select and copy text beside the scrollbar, each row no longer carries an extra block character at the end. ⟦Peeling tape off a wall used to snag a stray bit of residue along the edge that you had to pick off by hand, while now it pulls off in one clean strip from start to finish.⟧

items.original: Shift+drag selection beside the scrollbar no longer copies an extra block character at the end of each row

title.zh-TW: 終端機貼上大段文字不再停頓好幾秒
title.en: Large terminal pastes no longer stall for seconds

body.zh-TW:
整份會議記錄或長篇文章貼進對話框準備請 AI 處理，畫面卻突然停住沒辦法繼續操作。

現在就算用的是不支援 bracketed-paste（讓終端機分辨整段貼上與手動打字的功能）的終端機，貼上大段文字也不會再卡住好幾秒。⟦把整疊發票放進點鈔機時，以前沒有分批標記就得一張張慢吞吞重算，現在即使少了那道標記，機器也能順暢吞進去。⟧
body.en:
You paste a full meeting transcript or long article into the chat box for the AI to process, and the screen suddenly freezes so you cannot keep working.

Now, even if you use a terminal that lacks bracketed-paste (a feature that lets terminals tell a whole-block paste apart from manual typing), pasting large text no longer stalls for many seconds. ⟦Feeding a stack of receipts into a counter without a batch marker used to force it to recount them slowly one by one, and now it takes the whole stack smoothly even without that marker.⟧

items.original: Large pasted text no longer stalls for many seconds when the terminal lacks bracketed-paste support

title.zh-TW: Linux 在匯流排慢或 Kitty 無回應時啟動更快
title.en: Faster Linux startup when system bus is slow or Kitty is unresponsive

body.zh-TW:
Linux 使用者打開 Grok Build，有時還沒看見輸入畫面就得停在原地等著啟動。

現在遇到 system bus（Linux 系統內部傳遞訊息的通道）反應慢或沒有回應時，啟動速度會變得更快。

換成支援 Kitty 規格的終端機時，就算它一直沒回應鍵盤協定查詢（用來確認進階按鍵支援的詢問），啟動同樣變得更快。⟦搭電梯上班時，以前大廳感應器慢半拍或門禁機沒應聲，整台車就停著不動，現在這兩種狀況下開門起步都會快上不少。⟧
body.en:
Linux users opening Grok Build sometimes have to sit and wait for startup before even seeing the input screen.

Now, startup is faster when the system bus (the internal channel Linux uses to pass messages) is slow or unresponsive.

On a Kitty-capable terminal, startup is also faster even when it never answers the keyboard protocol query (a check for advanced key support). ⟦Taking an elevator to work used to leave the cab sitting still whenever the lobby sensor lagged or the badge reader stayed silent, whereas now it opens and gets moving much faster in both cases.⟧

items.original: Faster startup on Linux when the system bus is slow or unresponsive, and when a Kitty-capable terminal never answers the keyboard protocol query

title.zh-TW: Grep 與 10 項以上編號清單排版對齊
title.en: Grep and 10+ numbered lists align properly

body.zh-TW:
對照終端機裡的長清單或表格欄位，只要多縮進一格，整排字就會跟著錯位。

Grep（在檔案裡搜尋文字的工具）的結果現在會把 Tab 字元顯示成空白格，讓直欄能正確對齊。

工作流程階段和工具搜尋裡的編號清單，在項目達到 10 項以上時也能正常對齊。⟦排電影院座位表時，以前只要中間空位寬度沒算準，後面的號碼就跟著歪掉，現在每一格都按固定寬度留白，從頭到尾都能對成一直線。⟧
body.en:
When scanning a long list or table columns in the terminal, a single extra indent throws the whole row out of alignment.

Results from Grep (a tool for searching text in files) now display tab characters as spaces so columns line up correctly.

Numbered lists in workflow phases and tool search also align properly when there are 10 or more items. ⟦Laying out a movie theater seating chart used to skew every number behind a miscalculated aisle gap, and now each slot reserves a fixed width so the whole row stays in a straight line.⟧

items.original:
Grep results now display tab characters as spaces so columns line up correctly
Numbered lists in workflow phases and tool search now align correctly for 10+ items

title.zh-TW: 舊版 Windows 主控台待辦與捲動字元正常顯示
title.en: Pending todos and scrollback glyphs render on legacy Windows consoles

body.zh-TW:
仍在使用舊版 Windows 主控台的人，現在看操作進度與歷史紀錄不用再擔心畫面出狀況。

還沒處理完的待辦事項，在舊版主控台上已經能正確顯示。

往回捲動查看舊輸出時，畫面上的字元符號也都能正常繪製出來。⟦拿舊款印表機印新表格時，以前欄框和字跡常有漏印，現在整張紙上的項目與符號都能清楚印出來。⟧
body.en:
Anyone still using a legacy Windows console no longer has to worry about display glitches when checking progress and history.

Pending todos now render correctly on legacy Windows consoles.

Scrollback glyphs also render properly when scrolling back through earlier output. ⟦Printing a new form on an older printer used to leave missing borders and faint marks, but now every item and symbol on the page prints out clearly.⟧

items.original:
Pending todos now render correctly on legacy Windows consoles
Scrollback glyphs now render correctly on legacy Windows consoles

title.en: /rewind works in place for paged sessions

body.zh-TW: 對話拉長並切成好幾頁後，想往回退到前面某個步驟，往往得等整串紀錄重新讀取。現在輸入 `/rewind` 就能在分頁工作階段裡就地回溯，不會把每一輪對話全部重新載入。⟦看長片想倒帶重看某段時，以前拉回進度條得等整部片重新載入一遍，現在畫面會直接跳回那一秒。⟧
body.en: When a conversation grows long and splits across multiple pages, stepping back to an earlier point often meant waiting for the entire history to reload. Entering `/rewind` now rewinds in place within paged sessions without reloading every turn. ⟦Picture rewinding a long movie to rewatch a scene: dragging the slider back used to reload the whole film, whereas now the frame jumps straight to that second.⟧

items.original: `/rewind` now works in place for paged sessions without reloading every turn

title.zh-TW: /vim-mode all 開放完整 Vim 編輯
title.en: /vim-mode all enables full Vim editing

body.zh-TW:
習慣用 Vim 鍵位移動游標和改字的人，現在連代理人的輸入區都能全程套用。只要輸入 `/vim-mode all`，就能在代理人提示詞輸入框裡開啟完整的 Vim 編輯功能。

開啟後，鍵盤快捷鍵一覽表也會顯示 Vim Normal mode（只靠單鍵移動游標與改字的狀態）的獨立區塊。⟦開手排車上路時，以前進到市區還得切回自排，現在全程都能照手排檔位操作，旁邊還貼了一張檔位對照表。⟧
body.en:
Those used to moving the cursor and editing text with Vim keybindings can now use them all the way through the agent input area. Entering `/vim-mode all` turns on full Vim editing inside the agent prompt.

When enabled, Vim Normal mode (the state where single keys move the cursor and edit text) also appears as its own section in the keyboard shortcuts cheatsheet. ⟦Driving a stick shift used to mean switching back to automatic in city traffic, but now you can shift gears the whole trip with a gear chart taped right beside you.⟧

items.original:
`/vim-mode all` enables full Vim editing inside the agent prompt
Vim Normal mode now appears as a section in the keyboard shortcuts cheatsheet when enabled

title.zh-TW: 自動審查模式將整條提示列染成藍色
title.en: Auto-review mode tints the entire prompt bar blue

body.zh-TW: 在多種對話模式之間來回切換，靠顏色就能一眼分清目前處在哪一種。現在自動審查模式會把整條提示列染成藍色，跟規劃模式和提問模式的顯示方式一致。
body.en: When switching back and forth between conversation modes, color lets you tell at a glance which one is active. Auto-review mode now tints the entire prompt bar blue, matching how plan and ask modes appear.

items.original: Auto-review mode now tints the entire prompt bar blue, matching plan and ask modes

title.zh-TW: 提示詞佇列新增 WSL 切換與編輯標示
title.en: Prompt queue adds WSL toggle and editing label

body.zh-TW:
要把還沒送出的提示詞排成一列依序處理，現在連操作按鍵跟編輯標記都備齊了。在 Windows Terminal 裡透過 WSL（Windows 裡的 Linux 子系統）執行時，按 `Ctrl+Y` 就能切換提示詞佇列。

修改已經排進佇列的提示詞，那一列會變暗並顯示「editing」標籤。⟦在櫃檯拿叫號單排隊，想看清單按個鈕就叫得出來，臨時要改其中一單也會反灰標記，不會跟其他單混在一起。⟧
body.en:
Lining up unsent prompts to run in order now comes with both a toggle shortcut and an edit indicator. When running in WSL (the Linux subsystem on Windows) inside Windows Terminal, pressing `Ctrl+Y` toggles the prompt queue.

Editing a queued prompt dims the row and shows an "editing" label. ⟦Taking a numbered ticket at a counter lets you pull up the waitlist with one button, and updating a ticket grays it out so it never gets mixed up with the rest.⟧

items.original:
`Ctrl+Y` now toggles the prompt queue when running in WSL inside Windows Terminal
Editing a queued prompt now shows an "editing" label and dims the row

title.zh-TW: 輸入快捷鍵與啟動補全更順手
title.en: Smoother input shortcuts and startup completion

body.zh-TW:
在輸入框編輯草稿、叫出補全或貼上圖片，幾項按鍵行為與說明都跟著調整。

在精簡模式編輯草稿時，按 `Ctrl+E` 現在會把游標移到該行結尾。

剛啟動工具後，就算技能（預先寫好的擴充指令）還沒載入完成，`Tab` 鍵補全也能馬上使用。

針對 macOS 使用者，官方使用說明現在建議改用 `Ctrl+V` 來貼上螢幕截圖。
body.en:
Editing drafts, triggering completion, or pasting images in the input box gets a few updated key behaviors and docs.

When editing a draft in minimal mode, `Ctrl+E` now moves the cursor to the end of the line.

Right after startup, `Tab` completion works immediately even before skills (prewritten extension commands) finish loading.

For macOS users, the official documentation now recommends `Ctrl+V` to paste screenshots.

items.original:
`Ctrl+E` in minimal mode now moves the cursor to the end of line when editing a draft
macOS documentation now recommends `Ctrl+V` to paste screenshots
Tab completion now works immediately after startup even before skills load

title.zh-TW: 回覆區顯示與複製按鈕操作更正常

body.zh-TW:
查看 AI 產出的內容，裡頭常夾帶網址、程式碼、圖表和數學公式，這些元素的顯示與互動都有改善。 遇到打不開的網址時，畫面現在預設就會顯示連結卡片。 斜線選單或其他選單還開著的時候，程式碼區塊底下的複製按鈕依然可以直接點擊。 Mermaid（用文字語法畫流程圖的工具）圖表遇到 `\n` 和 `
` 時，現在會正確換行，不再把這幾個字元直接印出來。 Markdown 連結裡面如果夾帶 LaTeX（專門用來排數學公式的語法），現在會正常顯示為連結，不會誤判進入數學模式。
body.en:
Viewing AI output that mixes URLs, code, diagrams, and math formulas gets cleaner rendering and smoother interactions. Link cards now appear by default for links that cannot be opened. Copy buttons under code blocks remain clickable while slash or other menus are open. Mermaid (a tool for drawing flowcharts from text syntax) diagrams now break lines properly on `\n` and `
` instead of printing the literal characters. Markdown links containing LaTeX (syntax built for typesetting math formulas) now render as links instead of mistakenly entering math mode.

items.original:
Link cards now appear by default for links that cannot be opened Copy buttons under code blocks remain clickable while slash or other menus are open Mermaid diagrams now correctly break lines on `\n` and `
` instead of printing the literal characters Markdown links containing LaTeX now render correctly without entering math mode

title.zh-TW: 背景任務看得到數量且關閉畫面不誤停
title.en: Background task counts stay visible and safe on close

body.zh-TW:
讓指令或子代理（在背景分擔工作的助手）繼續執行時，最怕不清楚進度或手滑中斷。現在每輪對話結束的標記上，會直接顯示還有幾個背景指令正在跑。

如果不小心連點兩下關閉檢視畫面，也不會再把背景任務或子代理一起停掉。⟦廚房爐子上同時燉著幾鍋湯，計時器會清楚告訴你還有幾鍋在滾，不小心多按一次抽油煙機開關也不會把爐火一起關掉。⟧
body.en:
Leaving commands or subagents (helpers that split off work in the background) running makes it easy to lose track of progress or stop them by mistake. The end-of-turn marker now shows how many background commands are still running.

Double-clicking to close a view no longer accidentally stops a background task or subagent. ⟦Think of several pots simmering on a stove: a timer tells you how many are still bubbling, and hitting the range hood switch twice by mistake will not shut off the burners.⟧

items.original:
End-of-turn marker now shows how many background commands are still running
Double-clicking a view close no longer accidentally stops a background task or subagent

title.en: Deleted sessions stay hidden and feedback drafts open

清理過往對話或回頭找草稿，工作階段相關的清單與紀錄現在都能正確對應。

已經刪除的工作階段，現在不會再出現在恢復清單或標題搜尋結果裡。

從完整工作階段檢視畫面開啟已儲存的意見回饋草稿，現在也能正常打開。
body.en:
Whether cleaning up past conversations or returning to a draft, session lists and records now line up properly.

Deleted sessions no longer appear in resume lists or title searches.

Saved feedback drafts now open properly from the full session view.

items.original:
Deleted sessions no longer appear in resume lists or title searches
Saved feedback drafts now open correctly from the full session view

title.zh-TW: 刪除與登入驗證的提示訊息顯示更完整
title.en: Clearer delete and sign-in authentication messages

body.zh-TW:
刪除操作失敗或碰到登入驗證問題，畫面上跳出的提示和狀態回饋不再讓人一頭霧水。

刪除操作失敗時的錯誤訊息，現在會顯示完整文字，不會被截斷。

登入期間若遇到驗證錯誤，訊息不會再把背後原因重複列出來。

複製 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）登入網址後的回饋提示，現在會正確標示驗證狀態。
body.en:
When a delete action fails or sign-in hits an authentication snag, the on-screen prompts and status feedback are no longer confusing.

Delete error messages now show their full text instead of being cut off.

Authentication error messages during sign-in no longer repeat the underlying cause.

Feedback after copying an MCP (a protocol that connects AI to external tools) sign-in URL now correctly indicates verification status.

items.original:
Delete error messages now show their full text instead of being cut off
Authentication error messages during sign-in no longer repeat the underlying cause
MCP sign-in URL copy feedback now correctly indicates verification status

title.zh-TW: tmux 延遲警告與終端機畫面穩定修復
title.en: tmux delay warning and terminal display fixes

body.zh-TW:
用 tmux（終端機多視窗管理工具）開多視窗，或是把終端機視窗縮得很矮，畫面跟按鍵檢查都有對應補強。

如果 tmux 扣住 `Esc` 鍵超過 50 ms，執行 `/doctor` 檢查時現在會跳出警告。

在高度非常矮的終端機上顯示取消本輪對話的提示，也不會再讓 TUI（終端機裡的文字操作介面）當掉。

Running multiple panes with tmux (a terminal multiplexer for managing multiple panes) or shrinking the terminal window very short gets both key-check and display fixes.

`/doctor` now warns when tmux holds `Esc` for more than 50 ms.

body.zh-TW:
想請 AI 讀某個檔案卻不小心選錯，現在不用急著刪掉重來。用 `@` 插入的檔案標籤（輸入框裡那塊標示目標的小方塊）可以直接在原地修改，手動打 `@~/` 開頭的路徑也會自動對應到你的家目錄。

想指明特定行數或帶入隱藏檔，現在也支援在結尾加上 `:N` 行號後綴，以及用 `@!hidden` 語法點名隱藏檔。⟦就像在手機地圖設定目的地，以前打錯字得整格清空，現在能直接在欄位裡改字，還聽得懂捷徑、樓層和暗門。⟧
body.en:
If you want the AI to read a file but pick the wrong one, you no longer need to delete it and start over. File chips inserted with `@` (the small blocks in the input box that mark a target) can now be edited in place, and paths typed starting with `@~/` automatically resolve to your home folder.

items.original:
`@` file chips can now be edited in place; typed `@~/` paths resolve to the home folder
`@` mentions now support `:N` line suffixes and `@!hidden` files

title.zh-TW: 依安裝方式改善 `grok update` 更新指引
title.en: `grok update` guidance improved by installation method

想幫手上的 Grok 升級或切換更新頻道，結果常取決於你當初怎麼安裝它。如果你的 `bin/grok` 是透過 npm（JavaScript 套件管理工具）裝的，現在執行 `grok update --channel` 會直接跳出清楚的錯誤訊息與後續步驟。

改用 Homebrew cask（macOS 常用的軟體安裝工具）安裝的話，`grok update` 和切換頻道功能現在都能正常運作，畫面上也會顯示正確的指令。⟦好比在賣場辦退貨，以前不管從門市還是網購下單，櫃檯都只給同一張表單，現在會依你的購買管道，給出對得上的步驟和指示。⟧
body.en:
When you try to upgrade Grok or switch update channels, the outcome often depends on how you originally installed it. If your `bin/grok` was installed via npm (a JavaScript package manager), running `grok update --channel` now shows a clear error message and next steps.

For installations done through Homebrew cask (a common macOS software installer), `grok update` and channel switching now work properly, and the screen displays the right commands. ⟦Picture returning an item at a store: previously the counter handed out the same form whether you bought in person or online, but now it gives you steps and instructions that match how you purchased.⟧

items.original:
`grok update --channel` now gives a clear error and steps when `bin/grok` was installed by npm
`grok update` and channel switches now work correctly for Homebrew cask installs and show the right commands

title.zh-TW: 對話紀錄可跨區塊選取並複製彩色文字
title.en: Transcripts now support cross-block selection and copying colored text

body.zh-TW: 在對話紀錄裡想抄幾句回答，以前用滑鼠拖曳往往只能一整塊訊息全選，無法精準挑出要的片段。現在直接拖曳滑鼠，就能跨過不同訊息區塊反白選取，連帶有顏色的文字都能一起複製下來。⟦把報紙文章剪下來保存時，以前得把整版帶走，現在拿剪刀沿著需要的段落跨欄剪下，連彩色標題都能保留。⟧
body.en: When you wanted to copy a few lines from a reply in the transcript, dragging with the mouse used to select an entire message block instead of letting you pick just the snippet you needed. Now dragging the mouse highlights across different message blocks and lets you copy colored text along with it. ⟦When clipping a newspaper article to save, you used to have to take the whole page, whereas now you can cut across columns along just the paragraphs you want and even keep the colored headlines.⟧

items.original: Dragging in the transcript now selects and copies colored text across message blocks instead of whole blocks

title.zh-TW: `grok export` 匯出對話加速又省記憶體
title.en: `grok export` gets faster and uses less memory

body.zh-TW: 工作階段裡只要累積了大段終端機指令輸出，想把整段對話存成檔案就得靠 `grok export`（匯出對話紀錄的指令）。這類包含大量終端機輸出的工作階段，現在執行匯出時速度更快，佔用的記憶體也更少。⟦搬運一整箱厚重報表時，以前得來回扛好幾趟又佔滿走廊，現在換成輕巧推車，一下就運完還不佔空間。⟧

Exporting sessions with heavy terminal output is now faster and uses less memory. ⟦Moving a heavy crate of reports used to take multiple trips and clog the hallway, but switching to a light cart gets the job done quickly without taking up space.⟧

寫長段落想另起一行卻插不進去，往往是因為手邊的命令列視窗還沒被認出來。現在只要在設定檔加入這段設定，`Shift+Enter` 就能照常換行：


title.zh-TW: 工作階段重載或更新不再無故重啟 MCP 連線

body.en: When you reloaded or refreshed your current session, external tools used to disconnect and reconnect for no reason. Now when you reload or update a session, MCP (Model Context Protocol, a standard for connecting AI to external tools) server connections no longer go through these unnecessary restarts. ⟦When organizing a notebook on your desk, simply flipping back to reread a page used to switch the desk lamp off and on again; now only the pages turn while the lamp stays steadily lit.⟧

items.original: MCP server connections no longer restart unnecessarily on session reloads or updates

在對話介面複製連結、雙擊文字或按快捷鍵，過去偶爾會遇到畫面反應不如預期。

畫面上顯示的複製提示，現在也會和實際進到剪貼簿的內容一致。

⟦像拿著透明描圖紙抄資料，以前邊角總會漏掉幾筆、多點一下還把整頁折起來，現在描下來的跟底稿一模一樣，按鈕也處處順手。⟧
body.en:
When copying links, double-clicking text, or pressing shortcuts in the chat interface, the screen occasionally reacted unexpectedly.

When text is missing on screen, double-clicking used to fold thoughts, and it no longer does.

title.zh-TW: 回溯後底部上下文用量不再歸零或過時

items.original: Shell commands correctly handle startup functions containing special characters

title.zh-TW: 專案掛鉤與技能設定各自獨立，權限檔解析失敗跳警告
title.en: Project hooks and skill settings operate independently, with warnings when permission files fail to parse

body.zh-TW: 在多個儲存庫之間切換開發時，手動調整的設定若無聲無息失效，往往會引發意想不到的混亂。如果權限規則無法載入，例如語法解析錯誤或 `.claude/settings.json` 不是合法的 JSON 格式，現在開啟工作階段時會立刻跳出警告通知，不再默默略過。在 `/hooks` 停用某個專案的掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時觸發的小程式）時，修改範圍僅限於當前儲存庫，不會連帶停用其他專案裡的同名掛鉤。在 Skills 分頁開關個別技能時，只會將 `[skills].disabled` 項目儲存至 `config.toml`，由組織統一派送的技能資料夾與忽略清單會持續維持套用。以前規則寫錯常讓人摸不著頭緒，停用專案工具還會意外波及其他工作區；現在問題即時提醒，各專案的外掛設定也互不干擾。
body.en: When switching development across multiple repositories, manual settings that fail silently often cause unexpected confusion. If permission rules fail to load, such as when syntax does not parse or `.claude/settings.json` is not valid JSON, a warning notification now appears immediately when opening a session instead of being silently skipped. Disabling a project hook in `/hooks` applies only to the current repository, without disabling hooks (small programs triggered by specific events) of the same name in other repositories. Turning an individual skill on or off in the Skills tab saves only `[skills].disabled` to `config.toml`, so managed skill folders and ignore lists distributed by an organization keep applying. Previously, misconfigured rules were baffling and disabling a project tool could inadvertently affect other workspaces; now issues surface immediately and plugin settings for each project remain isolated.

title.zh-TW: 儀表板掌握背景代理動態，隨時中斷任務且按鈕支援懸停高亮
title.en: Dashboard tracks background agents, stops runs anytime, and highlights controls on hover

body.zh-TW: 指派背景代理同時處理多項任務時，能即時掌握真實進度並隨時喊停至關重要。⟦宛如操作中央監控台的調度員，螢幕上只會標明真正運轉中的機具數量，按下急停開關也能瞬間切斷作業，不必等巡檢單確認完畢。⟧工作流程狀態列現在會明確顯示「仍有多少代理正在執行」，而不是列出代理的建立總數。當背景任務跳出等待授權的確認卡片時，只要點擊工作列（dock，停靠在畫面邊緣的操作列）上的停止按鈕，就能立刻中止該背景執行，不必先被迫回答卡片。若工作階段仍有背景子代理或工作流程在跑，儀表板的清單項目會持續停留在「工作中」狀態，在此處停止該列也能徹底結束所有關聯任務。提問卡片的確認送出按鈕、儀表板彈出視窗的關閉鍵與摺疊的工作流程列，在滑鼠游標移過時也都會高亮醒目顯示。
body.en: When assigning background agents to handle multiple tasks at once, tracking real progress in real time and being able to halt runs at any moment is essential. ⟦Picture a dispatcher at a central monitoring console: the screens display only equipment actively running, and hitting an emergency stop cuts operations instantly without waiting to clear inspection slips.⟧ Workflow status lines now clearly say how many agents are still running instead of listing the total number created. When an approval card pops up for a background task, clicking the stop button in the dock (an action bar pinned along the screen edge) stops that background run immediately instead of forcing you to answer the card first. Dashboard rows stay in Working while a session has background subagents or workflow runs going, and stopping the row there completely ends all related tasks. A question card's `Enter:submit` button, the dashboard session popup's `[✗]`, and collapsed workflow rows also highlight prominently when hovered by the mouse pointer.

title.zh-TW: 拒絕變更保留手動存檔，不再覆寫你自己修改的內容
title.en: Rejecting changes preserves manual saves, preventing your own edits from being overwritten

body.zh-TW: 趁著模型產生程式碼的空檔順手修補檔案，最擔心的就是退回建議時自己的心血被一併沖掉。⟦恰似請裝潢師傅在設計圖紙上標記草案，就算你最後否決了他的整套改建構想，你自己先前用色筆畫上的插座標記依然完整保留。⟧以前若 Grok 漏偵測到你手動存檔，拒絕變更時就會覆寫你已儲存的修改。現在即使 Grok 漏偵測到存檔事件，當你選擇拒絕變更時，檔案中所有由你親自儲存的修改都會被完整保留下來。
body.en: Tinkering with files while waiting for a model to generate code comes with the worry that rejecting a suggestion will wipe away your own work. ⟦Think of asking a contractor to sketch proposals onto a blueprint: even if you reject the remodeling concept altogether, the outlet marks you penciled in beforehand remain intact.⟧ Previously, if Grok missed detecting a manual save, rejecting a change would overwrite the edits you had already stored. Now, even when Grok misses a save event, choosing to reject a change keeps all edits you saved to the file yourself completely intact.

items.original: Rejecting a change keeps edits you saved to the file yourself, even when Grok missed the save, instead of overwriting them

title.zh-TW: 匯出至無程式讀取的具名管道立即報錯，背景寫入時刪除不再報「Directory not empty」
title.en: Exporting to unread named pipes fails immediately, and deleting sessions during background writes avoids "Directory not empty"

body.zh-TW: 跨目錄恢復歷史工作階段或將對話匯出到管線，以往常因資料夾路徑與背景寫入而受阻。⟦跟翻閱隨身索引夾一樣，無論你在哪一個工作桌前翻開標籤，都能直接指引回當初存放卷宗的特定抽屜。⟧現在無論你從哪一個目錄啟動終端機，執行 `grok --resume <id>` 都會自動切換至當初記錄該工作階段（session，工作期間的對話與狀態紀錄）的資料夾開啟，不再直接報錯拒絕。當使用 `/export` 將對話匯出至沒有任何程式正在讀取的具名管道（讓程式經由特定路徑傳送資料的通道）時，Grok 會立即回報失敗，不再凍結到只能強制終止行程。執行 `grok sessions delete` 清理歷史紀錄時，即使其他背景行程仍在向該工作階段資料夾寫入資料，也不會再因「Directory not empty」錯誤而中斷。
body.en: Resuming past sessions across directories or piping conversations outward was often blocked by folder paths and background writes. ⟦Much like flipping through a portable index binder, opening a tab from any desk leads straight back to the specific drawer where the dossier was originally filed.⟧ Now, wherever you launch your terminal from, running `grok --resume <id>` automatically switches to open in the folder where the session (records of conversation and state during work) was recorded, instead of refusing outright. When using `/export` to send a conversation to a named pipe (a channel that passes data between programs via a file path) that nothing is reading, Grok fails right away instead of freezing until killed. When cleaning up history with `grok sessions delete`, it no longer fails with "Directory not empty" even while other background processes are still writing into that session folder.

items.original:
`grok --resume <id>` opens the session in the folder it was recorded in, wherever you launch Grok from, instead of refusing
`/export` to a named pipe that nothing is reading fails right away instead of freezing Grok until it is killed
`grok sessions delete` no longer fails with "Directory not empty" when another process is still writing into the session's folder

title.zh-TW: 提示詞支援首尾跳轉與選取，捲動歷史鍵入字元自動聚焦
title.en: Prompts support boundary jumps and selection, while typing in scrollback auto-focuses

body.zh-TW: 編輯長篇提示詞或翻閱歷史訊息時，頻繁切換游標與輸入焦點往往打斷思路。現在按 `Cmd+Up`/`Cmd+Down` 或 `Ctrl+Home`/`Ctrl+End` 可直達提示詞首尾，加按 `Shift` 能從目前游標選到提示詞開頭或結尾。在空白提示詞按 `Left` 鍵，從任何工作階段或歡迎畫面都能開啟儀表板。捲動歷史中按 `Ctrl+L` 可將選取的整則訊息或反白文字轉成引文填入提示詞，擴充套件改以 `/plugins` 開啟。捲動歷史取得焦點且未開啟 vim 鍵（用字母鍵移動與編輯文字的模式）時，鍵入數字或符號現在會跟字母一樣，移回提示詞並輸入；`?` 仍開啟指令區。當 `Ctrl+Enter` 被接收成一般 `Enter` 時，頁尾送出提示會顯示 `Enter Enter`，預設設定的 tmux（終端機分割工具）就是例子。
body.en: When editing lengthy prompts or reviewing message history, constantly switching cursor and input focus often interrupts your train of thought. Pressing `Cmd+Up`/`Cmd+Down` or `Ctrl+Home`/`Ctrl+End` now jumps directly to the start or end of the prompt, and adding `Shift` selects from the current cursor to the prompt start or end. Pressing `Left` on an empty prompt opens the dashboard from any session or welcome screen. In scrollback, pressing `Ctrl+L` adds a selected message or highlighted text to the prompt as a quote, while extensions now open via `/plugins` instead. Typing a digit or symbol while scrollback has focus, with vim keys (a mode using letter keys for navigation and editing) turned off, moves focus to the prompt and types it there, just as letters already do; `?` still opens the command palette. When `Ctrl+Enter` arrives as plain `Enter`, the footer send indicator displays `Enter Enter`, with tmux (a terminal multiplexer) under default settings being one example.

title.zh-TW: 狹小終端機介面自適應精簡，特殊字元與舊版主控台不再破圖
title.en: Compact terminals adaptively streamline UI, while special characters and legacy consoles display cleanly

body.zh-TW: 將視窗縮小或在舊版主控台操作時，擠成一團的文字與缺字方框往往讓人難以閱讀。在狹窄畫面中，頁尾與狀態列會自動精簡項目，防止按鈕重疊或被截斷。在高度不足的終端機開啟倒回（rewind，將對話復原至先前步驟）確認視窗，或在該確認視窗開著時縮小終端機，Grok 不再當機。emoji（表情符號）與按鍵符號精確依終端機實際寬度計算，列不再超出框線，也不再遺失列尾的 `…`。生成媒體路徑包含中日文字元或 Windows 格式時，檔名也能完整保留並貼合欄寬。在 Windows 舊版主控台（如 cmd.exe 與 PowerShell），清單列的符號改用相容字元，不再出現破圖空方框。16 色終端機則將貼上標籤與工具強調色改為其他次要文字使用的柔和灰，淺色主題下貼上標籤的括號也不再消失。
body.en: Shrinking windows or operating in legacy consoles often makes crowded text and missing character glyphs painful to read. In narrow screens, footer and status bars automatically drop or shorten items, preventing buttons from overlapping or being cut off. Opening a rewind (restoring a conversation to an earlier step) confirmation dialog on a short terminal, or shrinking the terminal while that window remains open, no longer crashes Grok. Emoji and keycap symbols are measured precisely to the terminal's actual rendering width, so rows no longer overflow their borders or lose their trailing `…`. When generated media paths contain Chinese or Japanese characters or Windows formats, file names remain intact and fit row widths. On older Windows consoles such as `cmd.exe` and PowerShell, symbols in list rows use compatible characters instead of rendering as broken empty boxes. Terminals with 16 colors display paste labels and tool accents in the muted gray used by other secondary text, and paste label brackets no longer vanish under the light theme.

title.zh-TW: 工具輸出截斷對齊程式碼規格，引文排版與排隊筆記顯示更完整
title.en: Tool output truncation aligns with code cells, while quote layout and queued notes display fully

body.zh-TW: 閱讀引文對話或檢查工具回傳的長文字時，清楚規整的排版能幫你迅速掌握關鍵細節。當 Fetch、網路搜尋或 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）的輸出過長被截斷時，底部會顯示如同程式碼單元的提示列，標明剩餘行數與展開按鍵。只隱藏一行時會顯示 `+1 line`。在排隊提示詞上方顯示的模型切換結果或就緒工作樹（worktree，讓專案平行開副本的功能），當提示詞開始執行時會持續保留在螢幕上，不再被捲出視野。在對話引文方面，引文內的程式碼區塊每一行都會整齊收在引用線下方，複製引文時參照連結會自動轉為行內連結，多行數學公式後的行號也標記正確。若點擊了當前環境無法開啟的連結或本機檔案，例如在無桌面畫面的遠端連線下，介面會明確顯示原因，不再毫無動靜。
body.en: Clear and disciplined formatting helps you quickly grasp key details when reading quoted dialogue or inspecting lengthy tool output. When output from Fetch, Web Search, or MCP (a protocol connecting AI to external tools) is cut off, the bottom displays an indicator row matching code cells to show remaining lines and your viewer key. A single hidden line reads `+1 line`. Notes above a queued prompt showing a model switch result or a ready worktree (a feature enabling parallel working copies for a project) stay on screen when execution starts, instead of scrolling out of view. Inside conversation quotes, every line of a code block stays neatly beneath the quote bars, copying a quote turns reference links into inline links, and lines following multi-line math are numbered correctly. Clicking a link or local file that cannot open in the current environment, such as over an SSH connection with no display, clearly explains why instead of doing nothing.

Long sessions use less memory: finished Markdown blocks far off screen release their rendered layout, and search still finds their text
Typing no longer lags when ffmpeg is not installed and `PATH` holds slow directories, such as Windows drives under WSL
Long pastes that arrive as keystrokes, such as pastes on native Windows or in terminals without bracketed paste, no longer freeze the prompt for seconds while the plan-mode tip is on
Pasting long single-line text such as logs, JSON or base64 into the prompt no longer freezes the TUI for seconds
File watching on Linux no longer keeps a CPU core busy for about a minute after startup in large repositories
Lower CPU use while subagents run: the TUI repaints only for animations on screen
`grok --resume <id>` opens much faster on large session stores, reading only the resumed session instead of every session

title.zh-TW: @ 檔案選擇器支援工作區外路徑與原地編輯
title.en: @ File Picker Supports Outside-Workspace Paths and In-Place Editing

body.zh-TW:
你在對話提示框輸入 `@` 挑選檔案時，經常需要引用專案資料夾以外的設定檔或參考資料。⟦宛如在通訊錄搜尋聯絡人，以前只能挑選同部門成員且點選後無法更動，現在不僅能跨部門翻找名冊，選取後還能隨時退格重選。⟧現在只要在 `@` 後方輸入 `/`、`~/` 或 `../` 開頭的路徑，選單就會直接列出該目錄下的檔案清單。如果不需要這項行為，可以在設定中加入：

```toml
[ui]
at_picker_outside_workspace = false
```

已經挑選進提示框的 `@` 檔案也能直接在原地修改。在標記結尾按下 `Backspace`，選單會沿著原本路徑再次展開；按下鍵盤的 `Left` 或 `Right` 方向鍵，則能把游標移入路徑文字之中直接編輯。
body.en:
When picking files with `@` in the prompt, you often need to reference configuration files or documentation outside the project folder. ⟦Browsing contacts in an address book once meant being restricted to your own department without any way to alter selections, but you can now search across departments and backspace to choose again at any time.⟧ Now, typing a path starting with `/`, `~/` or `../` after `@` lists files directly from that directory. If you do not need this behavior, add the following to your configuration:

```toml
[ui]
at_picker_outside_workspace = false
```

Picked `@` files in the prompt can also be edited directly in place. Pressing `Backspace` at the end of a token reopens the picker on its original path; pressing `Left` or `Right` arrow keys places the cursor inside the path text for direct editing.

items.original:
`@` paths outside the workspace: an `@` path that starts with `/`, `~/` or `../` lists files from that folder; set `[ui] at_picker_outside_workspace = false` to turn it off
Picked `@` files in the prompt can be edited in place: `Backspace` at the end of one reopens the picker on its path, and `Left` or `Right` puts the cursor inside it to change the path

title.zh-TW: 終端輸入支援換行與捷徑補齊，審查卡片提供攔截說明
title.en: Terminal Input Supports Newlines and Symlink Completion, with Explanations on Approval Cards

body.zh-TW:
在終端機輸入提示詞與處理互動卡片時，各項按鍵行為現在更符合操作預期。在 VS Code 或其他採用 Kitty 鍵盤協定的 xterm.js 終端機中，按下 `Shift+Enter` 現在會正常插入換行符號。

使用 `!` 模式輸入外部指令時，按下 Tab 鍵補齊功能現在會列出透過符號連結（symlink，指向另一個位置的捷徑檔）安裝的指令，例如 Homebrew、npm、rustup 與 Debian alternatives 的二進位執行檔。

當介面跳出指令審查卡片時，若自動審查攔截了指令或無法審查，卡片會清楚標註狀態，按下 `Ctrl+F` 還能查看審查者的詳細說明。

面對提問卡片時，按下 `Ctrl+Y` 不再於尚未回答時關閉卡片；輸入答案時，它會貼回先前用 `Ctrl+K` 剪下的文字。
body.en:
Key behavior now aligns more closely with expectations when typing prompts and interacting with cards in the terminal. In VS Code and other xterm.js-based terminals using the Kitty keyboard protocol, pressing `Shift+Enter` now properly inserts a newline.

In `!` mode, Tab completion now lists commands installed as symlinks (shortcut files pointing to another location), such as Homebrew, npm, rustup, and Debian alternatives binaries.

When a shell approval card pops up, the card clearly displays status when Auto-review blocked a command or could not review it, and pressing `Ctrl+F` shows the reviewer's detailed explanation.

On question cards, pressing `Ctrl+Y` no longer closes the card without an answer. While typing an answer, it pastes back text previously cut with `Ctrl+K`.

items.original:
Shift+Enter inserts a newline in VS Code and other xterm.js-based terminals that use the Kitty keyboard protocol
Shell approval cards say when Auto-review blocked a command or could not review it, and `Ctrl+F` shows the reviewer's explanation
`!` mode Tab completion offers commands installed as symlinks, such as Homebrew, npm, rustup and Debian alternatives binaries
`Ctrl+Y` on a question card no longer closes it without an answer; while you type an answer, it pastes back text cut with `Ctrl+K`

title.zh-TW: 回覆引用支援乾淨複製，補齊程式碼與登入網址面板
title.en: Clean Copying for Reply Quotes, Reliable Code Copying, and a Sign-In URL Panel

body.zh-TW:
整理對話紀錄中的程式碼與文字引用時，複製內容的操作變得更加順手。⟦好比在閱覽室整理摘錄，以前遇到無效連結或正在動筆時摘錄夾常會卡死，現在隨時都能把乾淨引文收進筆記。⟧回覆中的引用文字新增 `[Copy]` 按鈕，點擊後能直接複製為不帶 `>` 標記的 Markdown 格式。

當下方開著排隊中的提示詞準備編輯時，點擊紀錄裡的程式碼 `[Copy]` 會確實複製，不再出現複製無效或意外關閉編輯框的情況。

輸入 `/mcps` 時，若瀏覽器無法自動開啟 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器的登入網址，面板會直接顯示網址，方便按 `c` 或 `[copy the url]` 複製。
body.en:
Copying content is now much smoother when managing code and quotations in the transcript. ⟦Like sorting excerpts in a reading room, where clippings previously froze whenever you hit an invalid reference or started writing, clean quotations can now be collected into your notes at any time.⟧ Quotations in replies gain a `[Copy]` button that copies the text directly as Markdown without its `>` markers.

Clicking `[Copy]` on a code block in the transcript copies reliably while a queued prompt is open for editing, rather than failing to copy or unexpectedly closing the editor.

When running `/mcps`, if the browser cannot automatically open an MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol for connecting AI to external tools) server's sign-in URL, the panel displays the URL directly so you can copy it with `c` or `[copy the url]`.

items.original:
`/mcps`: when a browser cannot open an MCP server's sign-in URL, the URL shows in a panel you can copy with `c` or the `[copy the url]` button
Quotes in replies get a `[Copy]` button that copies the whole quote as Markdown without its `>` markers
A code block `[Copy]` in the transcript copies while a queued prompt is open for editing, instead of copying nothing or closing the edit

title.zh-TW: 支援普通點擊跳轉子代理，空格路徑完整連結不截斷
title.en: Plain Clicks Open Subagents, and Spaced Paths Form Complete Links Without Truncation

body.zh-TW:
在終端介面點選檔案路徑與代理連結時，跳轉與開啟機制變得更穩定。⟦恰似整修社區告示牌上的跳轉指引，以前按壓特殊開關常無反應，點開附件還會殘留廢棄底片；現在普通點選就能直通完整目標，也不再留下任何多餘行程。⟧具名子代理的連結現在只要普通點擊即可開啟。當你從 macOS 透過 SSH 連線操作，複合點擊訊號無法順利傳遞給 Grok 時，依然能順利點開子代理畫面。

從終端介面開啟連結與檔案時，修復了每次點擊都會在背景殘留殭屍行程的問題。

行內程式碼若包含帶空格的路徑，例如 `~/Library/Application Support/...`，只要檔案存在就會將整串路徑建為連結，不再於第一個空格處中斷。
body.en:
Navigation and opening mechanisms are more reliable when clicking file paths and agent links in the terminal interface. ⟦A renovated community noticeboard guides navigation smoothly: while pressing special switches once failed to respond and opening attachments left discarded films behind, a standard click now reaches the full target without lingering processes.⟧ Links to named subagents now open on a plain click. Even when connecting from macOS over SSH where modified clicks fail to reach Grok, you can still open subagent views smoothly.

Opening links and files from the terminal interface fixes an issue where every click left behind a zombie process in the background.

When inline code contains paths with spaces, such as `~/Library/Application Support/...`, the entire string links to the destination as long as the file exists, instead of truncating at the first space.

items.original:
Named subagent links open on a plain click, so they work over SSH from macOS where a modified click cannot reach Grok
Opening links and files from the TUI no longer leaves a zombie process behind for each click
File paths with spaces in inline code, such as `~/Library/Application Support/...`, link to the whole path when it exists instead of stopping at the first space

title.zh-TW: 子代理訊息改為靠左條列，快取損壞自動修復並補齊流程紀錄
title.en: Subagent Messages Left-Aligned, Corrupt Caches Auto-Repaired, and Workflow Logs Completed

body.zh-TW:
追蹤背景任務、工作流程與多個代理之間的協作時，排版與除錯資訊更為完整。子代理之間的對話訊息改為靠左條列顯示在標註發送者與接收者的項目符號下方，取代了過往置中排列的版面。

當內建技能、代理或工作流程在本機的快取（cache，把算過／查過的結果暫存起來直接用）清單遺失或損壞時，Grok 會主動重新整理，不再持續保留過期內容或導致每次同步都失敗。

對話紀錄裡的工作流程執行紀錄，結尾現在會直接顯示回傳的執行成果，不再只有單獨一個冒號。輸入 `/tasks` 時會清楚顯示任務執行的具體時間；若查詢未知的任務 ID，清單也會保留該列並標示錯誤訊息。
body.en:
Layout and debugging information are more comprehensive when tracking background tasks, workflows, and multi-agent collaboration. Messages between subagents now appear as left-aligned rows beneath the bullet marking the sender and recipient, replacing the previous centered layout.

When the local cache (temporary storage for computed or fetched results) manifest for built-in skills, agents, or workflows is missing or corrupt, Grok refreshes it automatically instead of staying outdated or failing every sync.

Workflow run lines in the transcript now end with the returned result rather than a bare colon. Entering `/tasks` clearly displays the specific time the task ran. Querying an unknown task ID keeps the row in place with its error message.

items.original:
Messages between subagents appear as left-aligned rows under the bullet that name the sender and recipient, replacing the centered rows
Built-in skills, agents and workflows are refreshed when their local cache's manifest is missing or corrupt, instead of staying outdated or failing every sync
Workflow run lines in the transcript end with what the run returned instead of a bare colon, `/tasks` shows the time it was taken, and polling an unknown task id leaves a row with its error

title.zh-TW: 恢復對話僅讀取指定紀錄，修復耗時顯示與損毀容錯
title.en: Resuming Sessions Reads Only Target Records, Fixing Duration Display and Corruption Handling

body.zh-TW:
重新載入過往對話時，舊紀錄的容錯能力與讀取速度皆有改善。⟦跟從存檔庫調閱歷史卷宗一樣，以前遇到破損頁面就整份報廢，翻找時還得整庫清點；現在直取目標檔案，部分墨跡模糊也能正常翻開。⟧執行 `grok --resume <id>` 時只讀取指定紀錄，不再掃描整個儲存庫，開啟速度加快。

恢復對話後，背景指令的完成狀態會標在原輪次中，並顯示實際執行時間，不再出現約 0.0s。

歷史紀錄若含未知的推論強度或損壞位元組，工作階段會以預設強度運作並提示一次，並排除損毀行。

使用 `grok -p --resume` 載入失敗會顯示具體原因而非固定報錯；加上 `--output-format json` 時，開啟前失敗會印出單一 JSON 錯誤。
body.en:
Tolerance for legacy transcripts and loading performance are both improved when reloading previous conversations. ⟦Just as pulling historical files from an archive once meant auditing every shelf and discarding entire folders over a torn page, you can now retrieve the target file directly even if parts of the ink are damaged.⟧ Running `grok --resume <id>` reads only the specified session instead of scanning the entire store, opening much faster.

After resuming a session, background command completion is recorded in the turn that ran it, showing the actual execution time rather than about 0.0s.

Sessions whose history contains an unrecognized reasoning effort or unreadable bytes run at the model's default effort with a single notice, leaving corrupted lines out of the transcript.

When loading fails under `grok -p --resume`, the interface displays the specific reason instead of a fixed error message. With `--output-format json`, failures before opening print a single JSON error.

items.original:
Resumed sessions show a background command's completion in the turn that ran it, with its real run time instead of about 0.0s
`grok -p --resume` shows why a session could not load instead of always "Session does not exist", and with `--output-format json` a resume, continue or fork that fails before the session opens prints one JSON error
Sessions with an unrecognized reasoning effort or unreadable bytes in their history resume instead of failing: the session runs at the model's default effort and says so once, and the unreadable lines are left out of the transcript
`grok --resume <id>` opens much faster on large session stores, reading only the resumed session instead of every session

title.zh-TW: 上下文視窗容量持續鎖定，分頁即時顯示並修復登出狀態
title.en: Context Window Capacity Remains Locked, Tabs Update Instantly, and Logout Persistence Fixed

body.zh-TW:
切換對話分頁與調整模型容量時，各項工作階段的狀態維持皆有加強。透過 `/context-window` 挑選較大的上下文視窗後，該設定現在會持續鎖定生效。即便對話長時間閒置、遇到請求限流等錯誤，在主動重啟之前都不會提早觸發內容壓縮。

使用 `/new` 開啟新分頁時，介面在新對話回覆前就會立刻顯示剛切換過去的上下文視窗大小。

執行 `grok logout` 登出後，即使背景有另一個 Grok 實體正在更新登入憑據，也不會在下次啟動時被自動重新登入，確保登出狀態持久有效。

如果刪除工作階段失敗，介面只會印出一次「Could not delete session」前綴提示，讓後續的具體錯誤原因能完整呈現，不再遭到切除。
body.en:
State persistence across sessions is strengthened when switching conversation tabs and adjusting model capacity. After selecting a larger context window via `/context-window`, that setting remains locked in effect. Even if a session sits idle for an extended period or encounters errors like rate limits, compaction will not trigger early before you restart.

Opening a new tab with `/new` immediately displays the context window size you just switched to before the new conversation replies.

After running `grok logout`, you will not be signed back in automatically on the next launch even if another running Grok instance refreshes credentials in the background, ensuring sign-out persists.

If deleting a session fails, the interface prints the "Could not delete session" prefix only once, allowing the specific failure reason to display fully without truncation.

items.original:
`/new` tabs show the context window you just switched to before the new session replies
`grok logout` stays signed out when another running Grok refreshes its sign-in, instead of signing you back in on the next launch
A failed session delete shows the "Could not delete session" prefix once, so the reason is no longer cut off
A larger context window picked with `/context-window` stays in effect, so compaction no longer starts early after the session sits idle, after a failed request such as a rate limit, or until you restart

title.zh-TW: 更新下載檢驗失敗保留原檔，加固沙盒防護與退出流程
title.en: Update Download Verification Failures Retain Original Binaries, Hardening Sandbox and Exit Flows

body.zh-TW:
升級版本或在隔離環境維護時，安裝與更新流程有了更健全的防護。⟦就像為大樓更新門禁，以前送來空包裹或檢驗失敗時舊閘門會直接被拆除，現在必須確認新零件無誤才允許替換。⟧在 Linux 與 macOS 執行 `grok update --force-reinstall` 或指定現有版本時，若下載未通過檢查會保留既有執行檔，不再直接刪除。

若代理伺服器或快取（cache，把算過／查過的結果暫存起來直接用）傳回空檔，安裝程式會保留原本檔案，不再誤報成功。

在歡迎畫面按 `Ctrl+U` 結束安裝時，會在正常時限內退出，不再於顯示「Update installed」後卡死。

透過設定或 `--sandbox` 指定沙盒時，未受限狀態下仍可跑 `grok update`；處於隔離沙盒時則不再自動更新，改為提示手動執行。
body.en:
Installation and update flows offer sturdier safeguards when upgrading versions or maintaining isolated environments. ⟦Upgrading access controls for a building once meant the old gate was dismantled even when an empty package arrived or inspections failed, whereas replacement is now permitted only after verifying the new hardware.⟧ When running `grok update --force-reinstall` or targeting the installed version on Linux and macOS, existing executables are retained if downloads fail their checks, rather than being deleted directly.

If a proxy or cache (temporary storage for computed or fetched results) returns an empty file, the installer keeps the original file instead of falsely reporting success.

Pressing `Ctrl+U` on the welcome screen to finish installation exits within the normal deadline, rather than hanging after displaying "Update installed".

When configuring a sandbox via settings or `--sandbox`, running `grok update` remains permitted in unconfined states; once confined in an isolated sandbox, Grok stops updating automatically and prompts you to run it manually instead.

items.original:
`grok update` still runs when `--sandbox` or config sets a sandbox profile, unless Grok is already running confined
Grok running confined in a sandbox never starts an update on its own and tells you to run `grok update` instead
Quitting to install an update with `Ctrl+U` on the welcome screen exits within the usual exit deadline instead of sometimes hanging after "Update installed"
`grok update --force-reinstall`, or `grok update --version` with the installed version, keeps your working `grok` on Linux and macOS when the download fails its checks, instead of deleting it
Installers keep the installed `grok` when a proxy or cache returns an empty download, instead of replacing it with an empty file and reporting success

title.zh-TW: Windows 替換檔案前驗證執行，修復舊版符號與編碼略過
title.en: Windows Verifies Execution Before Replacing Files, Fixing Legacy Symbols and Encoding Skips

body.zh-TW:
在 Windows 環境下安裝與操作時，多項系統相容性問題已獲得排解。Windows 安裝程式在替換 `grok.exe` 與 `agent.exe` 之前，會先驗證下載檔案能否正常執行；若下載內容有誤（如代理伺服器傳回封鎖頁面），會完整保留現有檔案。

在傳統的 `cmd.exe` 或 Windows PowerShell 主控台（console，命令列視窗）中，工作流程、儀表板、意見回饋與擴充套件對話框的狀態圖示與箭頭，會改以 `>`、`•`、`√` 或 `x` 顯示，不再呈現為空白方框。

部分 Windows 編輯器存檔時會附帶 UTF-8 位元組順序記號，現在含有此標記的自訂代理檔案都能正常載入，不再被直接略過。

當啟動出錯、切換 `/minimal` 或 `/fullscreen`，或是收到終止訊號時，Grok 會徹底退出，不再偶爾掛起。
body.en:
Multiple system compatibility issues have been resolved when installing and operating on Windows. Before replacing `grok.exe` and `agent.exe`, the Windows installer verifies that the downloaded build runs properly. If the download is invalid (such as when a proxy returns a blocked page), it keeps existing files intact.

On legacy consoles (command-line windows) such as `cmd.exe` and Windows PowerShell, status icons and selection arrows in workflow views, dashboards, feedback dialogs, and extensions dialogs now display as `>`, `•`, `√`, or `x` instead of empty boxes.

Some Windows editors save files with a UTF-8 byte order mark. Custom agent files containing this mark now load normally instead of being skipped.

Grok exits cleanly instead of occasionally hanging after startup errors, switching with `/minimal` or `/fullscreen`, or receiving termination signals.

items.original:
Windows: Grok exits fully after a startup error, a `/minimal` or `/fullscreen` switch, or a signal, instead of sometimes hanging
Windows installers check that the downloaded build runs before replacing `grok.exe` and `agent.exe`, and keep the existing install when it does not, such as when a proxy serves a blocked-download page
Windows: on older consoles such as plain `cmd.exe` and Windows PowerShell windows, status marks and selection arrows in workflow views, the dashboard, and the feedback and extensions dialogs show as `>`, `•`, `√` or `x` instead of empty boxes
Custom agent files saved with a UTF-8 byte order mark, as some Windows editors write them, load instead of being skipped

title.zh-TW: 命令列非 UTF-8 引數容錯啟動，無頭模式中止輸出結尾紀錄
title.en: Non-UTF-8 Command-Line Arguments Tolerated at Startup, and Headless Termination Adds Closing Record

body.zh-TW:
在自動化腳本或特殊系統編碼環境中執行時，啟動與非正常中斷的處置具備了完整防護。傳入無效的非 UTF-8 命令列引數不再導致 Grok 在啟動時崩潰。例如 `--cwd` 這類路徑參數能正常接收，而 `-p` 等文字參數則會顯示用法錯誤提示，不再直接閃退。

系統環境變數中若含有非 UTF-8 位元組，現在也不會再阻礙 Grok 正常啟動。

在無頭模式（headless，沒有終端機視窗／視覺介面的執行模式）下執行時，若被 Ctrl-C 或 SIGTERM 訊號中止，`json`、`streaming-json` 或 `streaming-messages-json` 串流會補上一筆結尾紀錄保留成果，不再直接中斷。
body.en:
Startup and abnormal termination handling are now fully protected when running in automation scripts or environments with specialized system encodings. Passing invalid non-UTF-8 command-line arguments no longer crashes Grok at startup. Path arguments such as `--cwd` are accepted properly, while text arguments such as `-p` display usage error messages instead of crashing instantly.

System environment variables containing non-UTF-8 bytes also no longer prevent Grok from starting normally.

When running in headless mode (an execution mode without a terminal window or visual interface), runs stopped by Ctrl-C or SIGTERM signals end their `json`, `streaming-json`, or `streaming-messages-json` streams with a closing record that preserves the run outcome, instead of cutting off abruptly.

items.original:
Command-line arguments that are not valid UTF-8 no longer crash `grok` at startup: paths such as `--cwd` accept them, and text such as `-p` gets a usage error
Environment variables with non-UTF-8 bytes no longer stop Grok from starting
Headless runs stopped by Ctrl-C or SIGTERM end their `json`, `streaming-json` or `streaming-messages-json` output with a closing record that keeps the run's outcome, instead of cutting off the stream

title.zh-TW: 修復單行長文字貼上凍結，解決打字延遲與沙盒卡死
title.en: Fix Freezes on Long Single-Line Pastes, Resolve Typing Lag and Sandbox Hangs

body.zh-TW:
在終端機輸入提示詞或貼上大量資料時，介面卡頓與凍結問題已經修復。將日誌、JSON 或 base64 等超長單行文字貼入提示框時，終端介面不再凍結數秒。

在原生 Windows 或不支援括號貼上的終端機中，貼上內容常轉為連續按鍵輸入；在開啟規劃模式提示時，這類長貼上不再導致輸入框卡住數秒。

當未安裝 ffmpeg 且 `PATH` 包含較慢的目錄時（例如 WSL 環境下的 Windows 磁碟機），打字不再延遲。

在 macOS 上，當終端介面在阻擋視窗伺服器的沙盒中執行時，介面也不再陷入凍結。
body.en:
When entering prompts or pasting large amounts of data in the terminal, interface stutter and freeze issues have been resolved. Pasting very long single-line text such as logs, JSON, or base64 into the prompt box no longer freezes the terminal interface for seconds.

On native Windows or in terminals without bracketed paste support, pasted content often arrives as a sequence of keystrokes. When the plan-mode tip is enabled, these long pastes no longer cause the prompt box to freeze for seconds.

Typing no longer lags when ffmpeg is not installed and `PATH` contains slow directories (such as Windows drives under WSL).

On macOS, when the terminal interface runs inside a sandbox that blocks the window server, the UI no longer freezes.

Typing no longer lags when ffmpeg is not installed and `PATH` holds slow directories, such as Windows drives under WSL
Long pastes that arrive as keystrokes, such as pastes on native Windows or in terminals without bracketed paste, no longer freeze the prompt for seconds while the plan-mode tip is on
Pasting long single-line text such as logs, JSON or base64 into the prompt no longer freezes the TUI for seconds

title.zh-TW: 長對話自動釋放排版記憶體，降低檔案監控與重繪 CPU 負擔
title.en: Release Layout Memory in Long Sessions, Reduce CPU Load from File Watching and Repaints

body.zh-TW:
處理大型專案或展開長篇對話時，記憶體與處理器資源的消耗得到有效控制。在長時間工作階段中，已經滾動到螢幕遠方的已完成 Markdown 區塊會主動釋放渲染好的排版版面，有效減少記憶體佔用；當你搜尋歷史訊息時，文字搜尋依然能順利找到它們。

在 Linux 系統的大型程式碼庫中，檔案監控功能修復了啟動後持續佔用單一 CPU 核心約一分鐘的問題。

當子代理在背景運作時，終端介面現在只針對畫面上的即時動畫進行重繪，減少子代理運作時的 CPU 消耗。
body.en:
When handling large projects or holding long conversations, memory and processor resource usage are kept under control. In long sessions, finished Markdown blocks that have scrolled far off screen proactively release their rendered layouts, effectively reducing memory usage. When you search message history, text search still finds them smoothly.

In large repositories on Linux, file watching fixes an issue where a single CPU core remained busy for about a minute after startup.

When subagents run in the background, the terminal interface now repaints only for on-screen animations, reducing CPU consumption while subagents are active.

Long sessions use less memory: finished Markdown blocks far off screen release their rendered layout, and search still finds their text
File watching on Linux no longer keeps a CPU core busy for about a minute after startup in large repositories
Lower CPU use while subagents run: the TUI repaints only for animations on screen

title.zh-TW: 補齊對話框省略符號，統一狀態燈號與搜尋醒目色彩
title.en: Add Dialog Ellipsis Marks, Unify Status Indicators and Search Highlight Colors

body.zh-TW:
在終端介面瀏覽各項面板、設定對話框與狀態提示時，畫面呈現更加精準一致。意見回饋若送出失敗，訊息會優先說明處理結果，隨後列出失敗原因並引導輸入 `/feedback` 重新發送。

當對話框的分頁標籤、快捷鍵說明或設定列超出寬度時，結尾會以 `…` 省略號收尾，不再直接被硬生生截斷。

搜尋提示詞歷史紀錄時，相符字母會以一致的顏色醒目標示，`/` 與 `@` 選單邊框計數也同步淡化。

儀表板在串流回覆時標頭會顯示 `Responding`，頁尾按鍵提示維持全小寫規範的 `new agent`。

工作流程標記與啟動中的 MCP 伺服器皆套用主題執行中色彩；精簡模式下登入失敗訊息也改以錯誤顏色顯示。
body.en:
Browsing panels, settings dialogs, and status prompts in the terminal interface now provides a more precise and consistent visual presentation. If feedback fails to send, the message leads with the outcome, then lists the failure reason and guides you to enter `/feedback` to retry.

When dialog tab labels, shortcut descriptions, or settings rows exceed their width, they end in an ellipsis `…` instead of being abruptly cut off.

When searching prompt history, matching letters are highlighted in a consistent color, and the counts on the `/` and `@` menu borders are dimmed as well.
